sneha:
[ siniha + ṇa= sineha, i-khye. nīti, dhātu. 241. sineha= sneha. nīti, sutta. 162. nirutti. 33. snaha + ṇa= sneha. kappadduma. siṇeha-prā, addhamāgadhī. ]  CL=7 (Ti) (1) That which is a fluid or sticky substance. (2) (A) Resin, fluid. (B) Element of cohesion (Āpodhātu). (C) Craving (taṇhā), sensual pleasure (kāma). (D) Diṭṭhi. (C) Oil or oily substance. (3) Loving. (4) Beloved friend and lover. (5) Dripping.
(1) Tattha aggarasa-parititto (aṃ, 2. 207) ti bhojanarasesu pāyāso, sneharasesu gosappi, kāsavarasesu khuddamadhu aneḷakaṃ, madhurasesu sakkarāti evamādayo aggarasā nāma. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 70. (2) (A) Sabbattha kāyāyatanaṃ sneho viya ----. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 348. Snehatintadubbalabhāvena vasā telapītapilotikā. Dī, ṭī, 2. 61. (B) Sneha-paretā (dī, 1. 70) ti udakasinehena pariggahitā. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 195. Snehavasena sneho. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 61. (C) Taṇhā, kāma. (D) diṭṭhi. Snehāti dve snehā taṇhā sneho ca diṭṭhi sneho ca. Cūḷani. 234-5. Yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho----. Ma, 1. 307. Sinehakaraṇavasena sneho. Ma, ṭṭha, 2. 188. (E) Sneho (kaṅkhā. 225) ti telaṃ. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 389. (3) Lobhe snehe ca brāhmaṇassa. Jā, 1. 202. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 11. (4) Sākacchā snehasaṃse vā. Milinda. 100. (5) Snehavasena sneho. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 61.

[ sneha + ṇa ]  CL=7 That which is moistened or has an oily substance.
Sneha (ma, 1. 307) nti sakhīraṃ. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 188.
[ sneha + ṇa ]  CL=7 The state of being sticky or oily. See - snehagata.
snehadukkha:
[ sneha + dukkha ]  CL=7 Pain or suffering due to affection or craving.
Tato sneho snehadukkhanti. Cūḷani, ṭṭha. 103.
snehagata:
[ sneha + gata ]  CL=7 Reached a state of being sticky or oily.
Snehavasena sneho. Soyeva snehabhāvaṃ gatattā snehagataṃ nāma. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 61.
snehahetuka: [ sneha + hetu + ka ]  CL=7 Having affection as the cause. aho sattānaṃ snehahetukaṃ dukkhaṃ. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 341.
snehaja:
[ sneha + jana + kvi ]  CL=7 That which caused by affection or craving.
Snehajā (saṃ,1.209) ti taṇhāsineho jāto. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 278.
snehanvaya: [ sneha + anvaya ]  CL=7 Following after affection or craving. See - Snehaja.
snehapaccaya:
[ sneha + paccaya ]  CL=7 A cause that is craving.
Tassa snehapaccayā ca nandīpaccayā ca rāga-paccayā ca nandīrāgapaccayā ca jātaṃ. Cūḷani. 236-7.
snehapareta:
[ sneha + pareta ]  CL=7 (1) That which is fully saturated with moisture. (2) That which is saturated by the moisture of water.
Snehaparetā (dī, 1. 70. Ma, 1. 344. Ma, 2. 207) ti udakasinehena parito gatā samantato phuṭṭhā. Dī, ṭī, 1. 263. (aṃ, ṭī, 3. 12) sneha-paretā (aṃ, 2. 21) ti udakasinehena pariggahitā. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 9.
sneharasa:
[ sneha + rasa ]  CL=7 The taste of moistening or being sticky.
Bhojanarase su pāyāso sneharasesu gosappi kasāvarasesu khuddamadhu aneḷakaṃ madhurasesu sakkarāti evamādayo aggarasā nāma. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 70.
snehasaṃseva:
[ sneha + saṃseva ]  CL=7 The companionship or association with affectionate friends.
Sākacchā sneha-saṃsevā. Milinda. 100.
snehasaṅgathita:
[ sneha + saṅgathita ]  CL=7 Attached by craving (taṇhā).
Snehasaṅgathitā ganthā (jā, 1. 202) ti ārammaṇesu allīyanalakkha-ṇena snehena saṅgathitā punappunaṃ uppādavasena ghaṭitā suttena pupphāni viya baddhā. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 13.
snehasecana:
[ sneha + secana ]  CL=7 Poured or sprinkled with water.
Pusanaṃ snehasecanaṃ pūraṇaṃ vā potthaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 100.
snehatintadubbala:
[ sneha + tinta + dubbala]  CL=7 That which has weak moisture or oiliness.
Snehatintadubbalabhāvena vasā tela pītapilotikā. Dī, ṭī, 2. 61. (ma, ṭī, 2. 133. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 232).
snehavigamana:
[ sneha + vigamana ]  CL=7 Free from moisture.
Evaṃ sati snehavigamanena sukkhattā thaddhā hutvā ----. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 138.
snehavirecana:
[ sneha + virecana ]  CL=7 The medicinal purgative liquid or the medicinal liquid used for purgation.
Tadā kira jetavane ekacce bhikkhū sneha-virecanaṃ piviṃsu. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 45.
snehayatisneheti:
[ siniha + ṇaya, ṇe + ti. nīti, dhātu. 248. sniyhati-၏kāriုka်. snehayati-saṃ. ]  CL=7 (1) That which causes affection or enjoy. (2) That which causes wetness to spread.
(1) mānasaṃ snehayati. Milinda. 141. (2) abhisandetī (dī, 1. 70. Ma, 1. Ma, 1. 344. Aṃ, 2. 21) ti temeti snehe-ti. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 226. Ma, ṭṭha, 2. 221. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 9.
snehānugata: [ sneha + anugata ]  CL=9 Followed by the viscous liquid called water. Nehānugatā (dī, 1. 70, 195) ti udakasinehena anugatā. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 195. Snehānugatā (dī, 1. 70, 195) ti udakasinehena anupavisanavasena gatā upagatā. Dī, ṭī, 1. 263. (-aṃ, ṭī, 3. 12).
snehānvaya:
[ sneha + anvaya ]  CL=7 Always follows after being sticky.
Te ve dhamme virūhanti, snehānvayamivosadhā. Aṃ, 1. 356.
snehūpasevana:
[ sneha + upasevana ]  CL=7 Associating with a beloved person.
Snehūpasevanena buddhi pariṇamati paripākaṃ gacchati. Milinda. 100.
snidda:
[ siniha + ta. i-khye. nīti, dhātu. 241. nirutti. 33. siniddha-kiု sniddha-pru. nīti, dhātu. 162. sniha + ta. sniyhitthāti sniddho. kappadduma. snigdha-saṃ. siṇiddha-prā, addhamāgadhī. siniddha-lañña်းkrañña့်. ]  CL=7 (1) That which is gentle or smooth. (2) A beloved friend.
(1) mudukā maddavā sniddhā. Apa, 2. 106. (2) siniddho sniddho savayopyatra. Dhāna, ṭī. 346.
sniyhati: [ siniha + ya + ti. snihyati-saṃ. ]  CL=7 See - snehayati.
snehasaseva:
[ sneha + saṃseva ]  CL=7 The companionship or association with affectionate friends.
Sākacchā sneha-saṃsevā. Milinda. 100.
